plans to have a network of more than 16 partner locations by the end of 2027. The network is expected to provide a strong foundation for growth in France while delivering the high-quality sales, service, and ownership experience Lucid customers expect.

"France is an important market for Lucid," said Lawrence Hamilton, President of Europe at Lucid. "With Emil Frey France, we are establishing a customer-focused presence that will deliver the sales, service, and ownership experience our vehicles and customers deserve."
In Europe, Lucid has physical retail or service locations in Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Switzerland, and Belgium.
